config.label: API key from https://ismalicious
config.description: API key from https://ismalicious.com/app/account. Optional: without it the server starts in bootstrap mode and offers bootstrap_key.

config.label: API secret paired with the key
config.description: API secret paired with the key

config.label: API base URL (defaults to https://ismalicious
config.description: API base URL (defaults to https://ismalicious.com/api; https://api.ismalicious.com reaches the API host directly)

config.label: Replaces every tool's timeout, in milliseconds (defaults: gate 15000, check_indicator 25000, CVE and exploited_cves 10000, search_indicators 20000, check_indicators 60000, check_password_exposure 10000, scan_email 20000, watch_domain 30000, watch_dependencies 45000, ack_finding 10000)
config.description: Replaces every tool's timeout, in milliseconds (defaults: gate 15000, check_indicator 25000, CVE and exploited_cves 10000, search_indicators 20000, check_indicators 60000, check_password_exposure 10000, scan_email 20000, watch_domain 30000, watch_dependencies 45000, ack_finding 10000). ISMALICIOUS_TIMEOUT_<TOOL>_MS, e.g. ISMALICIOUS_TIMEOUT_CHECK_INDICATOR_MS, sets one tool's timeout and wins over it

config.label: Base URL for bootstrap_key, a route only https://ismalicious
config.description: Base URL for bootstrap_key, a route only https://ismalicious.com/api serves (defaults to ISMALICIOUS_API_BASE, or https://ismalicious.com/api when that is api.ismalicious.com)

config.label: Result cache: 0 turns it off; N caps every tool's cache lifetime at N seconds (never raises one)
config.description: Result cache: 0 turns it off; N caps every tool's cache lifetime at N seconds (never raises one)

config.label: 0 (or false, off, no) skips the one unauthenticated GET /health sent after initialize to open the connection
config.description: 0 (or false, off, no) skips the one unauthenticated GET /health sent after initialize to open the connection

config.label: Bearer <apiKey>:<apiSecret>, the key pair from https://ismalicious
config.description: Bearer <apiKey>:<apiSecret>, the key pair from https://ismalicious.com/app/account. Every tool but check_password_exposure (local only) and bootstrap_key.
